max_hold_exit: if neither stop nor target is hit, exit at close of the 18th 4h bar after entry
intrabar_collision: if both stop and target are touched in one candle, book stop first
gap_policy: entry is exact next 4h open; if that open is already beyond the frozen stop level, reject the setup as invalid geometry; if entry is beyond target level, reject as invalid geometry
r_accounting: 1R equals absolute entry-to-stop price distance; trading costs and funding are converted to R using entry notional return divided by stop-distance return
funding_exit_timestamp: for stop/target event, use end timestamp of triggering 4h candle; for max-hold exit use end timestamp of 18th held candle
bootstrap: 200 trials, 14-trade circular blocks, positive total net R fraction
drawdown: peak-to-trough cumulative net R across closed trades ordered by exit time
